label: Cisco Catalyst 1000 C1000-48FP-4G-L
description: Cisco Catalyst 1000 C1000-48FP-4G-L - 48x 1G RJ-45 all PoE+ (802.3af/at, 30 W a port, 740 W budget), 4x 1G SFP uplink cages, 104 Gbps switching bandwidth, 77.38 Mpps at 64 bytes, fan-cooled 1U Cisco IOS L2 access switch.

poe.note: 740 W PoE budget across 48 PoE+ ports, IEEE 802.3af/802.3at PSE, 30 W maximum a port. Perpetual PoE holds power on the PD across a reload. The budget, not the port count, is the ceiling: 48 Class-3 (15.4 W) PDs or 24 30 W PDs fit (48 x 15.4 W = 739.2 W, 24 x 30 W = 720 W).

notes: Datasheet Table 1 and Table 2: 48 copper ports, 4x 1G SFP uplink cages, 740 W PoE budget, one fan, 47.6 dB sound pressure, 17.48 x 13.78 x 1.73 in deep, 5.82 kg; single internal autoranging 100-240 VAC supply; 77.38 Mpps forwarding rate; 16,000 unicast MAC entries, 256 active VLANs, 4094 VLAN IDs, 64 STP instances, 9198-byte L3 MTU, 10,240-byte jumbo frame. The switching bandwidth is the sum of every port at line rate, so no port group is oversubscribed. RJ-45 console (EIA/TIA-232) at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity, no flow control; a USB Type A port takes a FAT-formatted flash drive for image and configuration recovery. Cisco calls the series Layer 2, but Table 2 budgets 542 IPv4 direct and 256 indirect routes (414/128 for IPv6), so static inter-VLAN routing is modelled as l3-forward, not a full L3 feature set. No 802.3bt anywhere in the series: 30 W a port is the ceiling. 740 W covers all 48 ports at Class 3 (739.2 W) or 24 at 30 W, and 47.6 dB is the loudest box in the series.
